[[Darth Zhorrid]], a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], owned an '''estate''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Begeren]]. Between receiving tasks from her [[Parent/Legends|father]] [[Darth Jadus]], Zhorrid returned to her estates on Begeren as well as the planets [[Sernpidal/Legends|Sernpidal]] and [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], where she spent her free time indulging in a variety of luxuries and horrors.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Darth Zhorrid's estates were first mentioned in the Codex entry for the Sith Lord in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
